purpose: Research-only acceptance design; these are specifications, not executed tests or runtime fixtures.

cases.expect: Retain the broad period; no automatic all-of bliaut, houppelande or hennin profile.
Do not require a Victorian bustle or historical full-length gown.

cases.request: 버슬 없이 매끈하게 떨어지는 현대 드레스
cases.expect: Excluded bustle must not return as required evidence or an adopted suggestion.

cases.request: a wolf with a thick neck ruff
cases.expect: Animal fur remains subject anatomy; no historical ruff collar or female costume is activated.

cases.request: 브로더리 앙글레즈 아이렛 자수 미니 드레스
cases.expect: Embroidery does not activate a robe à l'anglaise fitted-back historical garment contract.

cases.request: a bicycle with two pannier bags
cases.expect: No skirt support, costume or human subject inference.

cases.request: natural form light on upper-lip topography
cases.expect: No late-1870s dress or princess-line requirement.
Historical headwear context does not replace the locked modern jacket or require an S-bend silhouette.

cases.request: 옆구리 피부가 보이는 현대 컷아웃 원피스
cases.expect: Do not substitute a sideless surcoat with a complete underdress.
Preserve raised-waist geometry without adding Regency accessories or historical capture style.

cases.request: Spencer standing next to a long coat on a mannequin
cases.expect: The name alone does not dress the person in a short spencer jacket.

cases.request: 1760년경 프랑세즈의 등 주름을 충실히 재현한 복제 가운
cases.expect: Do not add punk repair seams, asymmetric pannier alterations, or deconstruction from adjacent candidates.
Equivalent lexical senses may retrieve equivalent optional candidates after independent core interpretation; spelling normalization does not itself grant hard authority.
Keep the requested silhouette variant; modern hennin usage must not be collapsed to one mandatory cone.
Do not copy identical garment extent into both senses.
Keep undergarment and outer gown senses separate; neither triggers forced transparency or undressing.

cases.request: 몸에 맞는 앙글레즈 등판에 폴로네즈식으로 겉치마를 걷어 올린 가운
cases.expect: Represent compatible back construction and skirt treatment as separate relations; no automatic mutual-exclusion failure.

cases.request: 불투명한 실크 가운을 입은 전신 사진, 크리놀린이 만드는 실루엣
cases.expect: Evaluate outer silhouette; do not expose or claim observation of hidden hoops.

cases.request: 사람 없이 케이지 크리놀린 구조를 보여 주는 박물관 전시 사진
cases.expect: Use a support-object context; no obligatory human model, face, body shape or ornate outer gown.

cases.request: 프랑세즈 가운의 앞면만 찍은 정면 사진
cases.expect: Preserve front-only framing. Back-pleat pixel verification remains unobservable in this case; no silent camera rotation or impossible simultaneous full front/back duty.

cases.request: 포어파트와 안소매 관계를 보여 주는 튜더 가운
cases.expect: Selected component bundle must carry every selected component's literal evidence and correct garment ownership into the final prompt.

cases.request: 여기서 파니에는 치마가 아니라 내 판타지 세계의 날개 장비 이름이야
cases.expect: Requester definition overrides generic clothing sense and local candidates; do not replace it with skirt supports.
Research confusion lists stay in diagnostics; do not paste blanket genre, body or wardrobe negatives into the generation request.
Keep accession date, stylistic evidence and unresolved alteration separate; do not certify an 1851 bustle norm.
Replica stomacher and display support are not catalogued as surviving original components.
Retain object-specific claims; no universal corsetless requirement or inferred hidden underwear.

required_observations: upper-back pleat origin versus fitted back
whether cloth falls freely across the waist
cases.confound_control: Comparable cloth pattern and lighting; no labels giving the garment name.

required_observations: sloping upper-skirt outline versus projecting upper edge
location of the turn from outward spread to downward fall

cases.views: matched views within a declared support-display mode; separate matched clothed-silhouette cases
required_observations: lateral width
front-to-back depth
height and direction of rear projection
location of greatest sleeve volume
narrow or open sleeve end
presence and position of intermediate constriction

cases.views: three-quarter view of arm attachment and torso side
required_observations: sleeve-to-bodice attachment ownership
complete lower garment visible through outer-garment opening

cases.views: three-quarter head view after original-portrait crosscheck
required_observations: angular versus rounded front edge
fabric continuation behind head

cases.views: full length with visible layer boundaries
required_observations: outer-jacket hem versus long coat extent
ownership of the skirt below the jacket
height of rear volume
whether long fitted panels continue over the hips
train versus elevated shelf distinction

cases.views: front full length with arms sufficiently clear
required_observations: separate textile inside the inverted-V skirt opening
outer cuff surrounding an inner sleeve
continuity of the outer gown

cases.views: full length with bodice termination visible
required_observations: actual bodice-to-skirt seam height
sash position distinguished from the construction seam

qualification_rules.pixel_hard_obligation: partial, absent or unobservable required evidence cannot receive PASS
qualification_rules.front_and_back: Use separate diagnostic requests when both views are required; do not change an original locked view.
qualification_rules.baseline: For an implementation experiment preserve the same raw request, immutable pre-retrieval core, generation model and image format; record any necessarily changed condition.
qualification_rules.attempt_policy: Choose and record attempt count before generating; retain all attempts and no best-of-only reporting.
qualification_rules.frozen_holdout: Freeze natural-language evaluation cases before implementation; cases above are design examples, not blind holdouts.
qualification_rules.user_judgment: pending until supplied by the user
